plan.planSummary: S24 "FR Transition Bridge" wires the post-CiviCRM-cutover face-recognition stack to the new contacts/events schema. The work splits into a DB layer (Alembic migration + ORM stubs for BiometricConsent and the two _legacy_civicrm stash columns absent from the models), a backend service layer (remap of ComprefaceSubject.contact_id / Detection.event_id|matched_name via external_id maps, consent backfill, verification endpoint, orphan relink/retire endpoints, pipeline dedup fixes in pit/task_service/face_pipeline, scoring documentation, enroll_without_consent guard), and a frontend layer (Settings FR Transition card, orphan review page, consent-needed badge on contact detail). Verified facts: current alembic head is eed28c4ef46a (linear, confirmed via `alembic heads`); the stash columns are created by g7h8i9j0k1l2 in Postgres but ABSENT from the ORM models so SQLite create_all won't build them (P02 required); AdminSetting stores values as `{"value": <actual>}` JSON dicts (settings.py line 82-89); face_pipeline tier-100 ALREADY uses the correct (contact_id,event_id) dedup and source='face' (T04 only needs the task_service + pit fixes); reassign_subject_contact takes a compreface_subject_id STRING not the integer PK (T07 must look up the string first); Participant has UniqueConstraint uq_participant_event_contact on (event_id,contact_id). Migration order is critical: P01+P02 (model stubs) must land before T01 (migration) which must land before T02/T03 and all tests T09.

featureTasks.name: T01 — Alembic Migration: S24 FR Transition Bridge
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: `alembic upgrade head` runs clean on both SQLite (test) and is structured for Postgres; second run is a no-op (idempotent via sa_inspect guards). After upgrade: stash columns _legacy_civicrm_contact_id/_legacy_civicrm_event_id are dropped; compreface_subjects.contact_id is remapped via contacts.external_id; detections.event_id remapped via events.external_id; detections.matched_name remapped from member:{old} to member:{new}. biometric_consent table exists with id PK, contact_id (FK contacts CASCADE, UNIQUE), consent_given bool, consented_at nullable, basis_note text nullable, recorded_at datetime default utc_now — guarded by `if 'biometric_consent' not in existing_tables`. If contacts.external_id is entirely NULL the migration raises a clear RuntimeError before mutating. Unmatched subjects are written to job_runs ONLY if has_table('job_runs') AND the detail column exists, else logger.warning. downgrade() drops biometric_consent and re-adds (empty) stash columns; documented as irreversible for data.
featureTasks.filesToChange: backend/alembic/versions/s24_fr_transition_bridge.py (new — pick a fresh unique revision id, e.g. s24a1b2c3d4e5; down_revision='eed28c4ef46a')
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Copy the header/idempotency pattern verbatim from eed28c4ef46a (the _JSONB with_variant alias at module top; `bind = op.get_bind()`, `insp = sa_inspect(bind)`, `existing_tables = insp.get_table_names()`). Dual-dialect remap: branch on `bind.dialect.name == 'postgresql'`. Postgres uses `UPDATE compreface_subjects AS cs SET contact_id = c.id FROM contacts c WHERE c.external_id = cs._legacy_civicrm_contact_id`; SQLite uses correlated subquery `UPDATE compreface_subjects SET contact_id = (SELECT c.id FROM contacts c WHERE c.external_id = compreface_subjects._legacy_civicrm_contact_id) WHERE _legacy_civicrm_contact_id IS NOT NULL`. Same shape for detections.event_id via events.external_id. matched_name remap: only rows matching `member:<int>`; SQLite has no easy regex so do it via a join-driven UPDATE using a derived map (UPDATE detections SET matched_name='member:'||(subquery new id) WHERE matched_name LIKE 'member:%' AND the suffix is the old external_id). Stash columns may NOT exist on a fresh SQLite create_all DB if P02 lands them as real columns — they WILL exist (P02 adds them to the model), so guard `op.drop_column` with `if col in [c['name'] for c in insp.get_columns('compreface_subjects')]`. Use op.batch_alter_table(recreate='always') for SQLite-safe drop_column and for adding the biometric_consent UNIQUE. RISK: job_runs is S16-owned and may lack a 'detail' column (recon risk #2) — guard with has_table AND column-presence check, fall back to logger.warning. utc_now: import from app or use sa.func default; biometric_consent.recorded_at default should mirror models (server-side default not required for tests since create_all uses the model). The all-NULL external_id abort check: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL` == 0 AND there is at least one subject with a stash value → raise RuntimeError('S24 abort: contacts.external_id all NULL; run S06 import first').

featureTasks.name: T02 — FR Remap Service + Consent Backfill Script
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: remap_subjects(db) is idempotent (two calls → identical final state) and returns RemapReport TypedDict (subjects_remapped, subjects_orphaned, detections_event_remapped, detections_name_remapped, orphaned_subject_ids). backfill_consent(db) on 3 active remapped subjects with no consent rows creates exactly 3 BiometricConsent(consent_given=False, basis_note='pre-cutover-unknown', recorded_at=utc_now()) and upserts admin_settings key 'enroll_without_consent' to {'value': True}; second call creates 0 rows and returns already_had_consent=3. Subjects with enrollment_status!='active' or contact_id IS NULL are skipped. Returns ConsentBackfillReport (consent_rows_created, already_had_consent, enroll_without_consent_set). scripts/backfill_consent.py runs as `python scripts/backfill_consent.py` from backend/ and prints a summary. All public functions fully type-hinted; no live CompreFace/Claude calls.
featureTasks.engineerNotes: remap_subjects uses pure `sqlalchemy.update()` statements (not ORM row iteration) for the ~1,440 rows, branching on `db.get_bind().dialect.name` exactly like T01 (UPDATE…FROM for pg, correlated subquery for sqlite). Note this OVERLAPS the migration's remap — by design remap is idempotent so re-running post-migration is a no-op; orphan counts come from a SELECT of subjects whose contact_id IS NULL but that have a non-null stash (post-migration the stash is dropped, so for the SERVICE path compute orphaned as active subjects with contact_id IS NULL). matched_name remap: SELECT detections WHERE matched_name LIKE 'member:%', parse the int suffix in Python, map old external_id→contact.id, skip non-matching/free-text, issue update only for matched. AdminSetting upsert: replicate settings.py lines 75-91 exactly — select by key, if exists set .value={'value':True} else add AdminSetting(key='enroll_without_consent', value={'value':True}, category='general'). Import BiometricConsent and AdminSetting from app.models. The CLI wrapper builds its own AsyncSession via the app's async_session_maker and calls asyncio.run(); print the report dict fields.

Non-admin→403, unauthenticated→401. In test env (legacy_settings.ENVIRONMENT=='test') smoke_test=={status:'skip',detail:'test-env'}. Response matches FRTransitionStatus Pydantic schema exactly. POST /admin/fr-transition/remap returns RemapReport dict; POST /admin/fr-transition/consent-backfill returns ConsentBackfillReport dict. Router registered in main.py with no /api prefix and dependencies=[Depends(check_setup_complete)].

plan.risks: CRITICAL ORDERING: P01 (BiometricConsent model) and P02 (stash columns on ORM) MUST land before T01 (migration), which must land before T02/T03/T05/T08 and all T09 tests — otherwise SQLite create_all builds an incomplete schema and seed-tests fail with 'no column named _legacy_civicrm_contact_id'. 1) T04 dedup change in _log_attendance is behavioral: switching (detection_id,event_id)→(contact_id,event_id) aligns with uq_participant_event_contact but may break existing assertions in test_task_service.py / test_tasks_full.py — audit and update those. member_id extraction MUST be reordered BEFORE the dedup SELECT. 2) T01 job_runs write: job_runs is S16-owned and may lack a 'detail' column (verified queue_manager guards its writes) — guard with has_table AND column presence, fall back to logger.warning. 3) T07 reassign_subject_contact takes a compreface_subject_id STRING not the integer PK — the relink endpoint must look up subject.compreface_subject_id from the integer id before calling the service. 4) AdminSetting stores {'value': <actual>} JSON dicts (settings.py 82-89) — the enroll_without_consent upsert and get_enroll_without_consent helper must use this shape, not bare booleans. 5) face_pipeline tier-100 is ALREADY correct (contact_id,event_id dedup + source='face') — T04 must NOT re-touch its logic, only add the scoring docstring. 6) BiometricConsent UNIQUE on contact_id + T01 idempotency guard must coexist so S08 can later own the full schema without a CREATE conflict. 7) Frontend service paths are '/admin/fr-transition/...' against axios base '/api' (nginx strips /api) — must match backend prefix exactly. 8) T03 prod smoke test returns 'skip' on an empty system (no subjects) — acceptable but document for operators."

recon.stack: Backend: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async (mapped_column/Mapped) + Alembic + PostgreSQL (asyncpg) / SQLite (aiosqlite for tests). Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS + TanStack Query + Zustand + sonner (toasts) + axios. Cache/Queue: Redis (slowapi, SSE via custom broadcaster, JWT JTI denylist). Async pattern: async/await throughout all I/O paths. Auth: in-memory Zustand access token + HttpOnly refresh cookie; `require_admin` / `require_volunteer` / `require_viewer` dependency chain. ORM: declarative Base from sqlalchemy.orm, Mapped/mapped_column syntax, utc_now() helper for naive UTC datetimes. JSONB: `JSON().with_variant(JSONB, "postgresql")` pattern used everywhere. Alembic migrations: idempotency via `sa_inspect` guards, `with op.batch_alter_table(..., recreate="always")` for SQLite-safe FK changes. Test framework: pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient, SQLite aiosqlite, in-memory Redis. Frontend API calls: axios instance at `/api` base, Bearer token injected per request, error surfaced via `err.response?.data?.detail`.

recon.patterns: Auth: `Depends(require_admin)` for all admin endpoints; 403 is standard non-admin response. Router registration: `app.include_router(router, dependencies=[Depends(check_setup_complete)])` pattern in main.py. ORM model columns: `Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)` for nullable FK columns. Datetime: always naive UTC via `utc_now()` helper (no tzinfo stored). JSONB: `JSON().with_variant(JSONB("postgresql"), "postgresql")` for cross-dialect support; JSON columns use server_default `sa.text("'{}'")` on Postgres. Alembic idempotency: wrap every op in `sa_inspect` guard (`if "table_name" not in existing_tables`); use `with op.batch_alter_table(..., recreate="always")` for SQLite-safe FK/column changes. Pydantic schemas: all response schemas use `model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)`. AdminSetting upsert pattern: select-then-insert-or-update with `value={"value": actual_value}`. Error handling in routers: raise `HTTPException(status_code=..., detail="...")`. Frontend services: `api.get/post/patch<ResponseType>(url, params/data)` then return `resp.data`; error surfaced via `err.response?.data?.detail`. Frontend toasts: `toast.success(...)` / `toast.error(err.response?.data?.detail || "Fallback")`. TailwindCSS: design tokens like `bg-card`, `text-foreground`, `bg-background`, `border-border`, `text-foreground/50`. Test async pattern: `@pytest.mark.asyncio`, `pytest_asyncio.fixture`, `AsyncClient` from httpx; seed with `db_session.add(model); await db_session.commit(); await db_session.refresh(model)`. Naming: snake_case for Python files/functions/variables; PascalCase for React components and TypeScript interfaces; kebab-case for route paths. Router file naming mirrors the URL prefix (e.g. fr_transition.py → /admin/fr-transition prefix). Dedup for Participant: UNIQUE constraint `uq_participant_event_contact` on (event_id, contact_id) — must use (contact_id, event_id) in SELECT guard, not (detection_id, event_id). Service idempotency: check before insert (SELECT ... scalar_one_or_none()); catch IntegrityError as fallback.
recon.risks:
1. T04 dedup regression: Changing `_log_attendance` dedup from `(detection_id, event_id)` to `(contact_id, event_id)` is a behavioral change. The old check allowed the same contact to get multiple participant rows from different detections in the same event (from different task resolutions). The new check aligns with the DB UNIQUE constraint but could change behavior for existing tests in test_task_service.py and test_tasks_full.py — these must be audited for breakage.

2. T01 migration `job_runs` write: The spec says to write unmatched subjects to `job_runs.detail`. The `job_runs` table is owned by S16 and only written via a guarded INSERT (queue_manager.py line 374). The `job_runs` table schema (columns: job_name, ran_at) does not obviously include a `detail` column — the migration must guard this write or skip it if the table/column is absent, matching the queue_manager pattern.

3. P01/P02 model additions with existing migrations: Adding `_legacy_civicrm_contact_id` to ComprefaceSubject and `_legacy_civicrm_event_id` to Detection ORM classes (P02) means `Base.metadata.create_all` in tests will now include these columns. This is the desired fix, but tests that assert exact column sets on these tables could unexpectedly pass or fail depending on column order. No breakage expected from the addition alone, but T09 tests depend on P02 being applied first.

4. BiometricConsent UNIQUE on contact_id: The stub table has `UNIQUE` on `contact_id` FK. If S08 lands later and tries to recreate this table without the idempotency guard, it will conflict. The migration (T01) must use the `if "biometric_consent" not in existing_tables` guard pattern.

5. T03 smoke test in production: The smoke test queries for any active ComprefaceSubject with non-null contact_id. In an empty production system (no subjects yet), this will always return `skip`. This is acceptable per spec but should be documented so operators understand a `skip` in prod may mean "no subjects yet" rather than "test passed."

6. Frontend T06/T07 — new services/frTransition.ts has no existing pattern for the three new endpoints — implementers must ensure the `/admin/fr-transition/...` paths match exactly what the backend exposes (no `/api` prefix in FastAPI; nginx strips it; the axios base is `/api`).

7. T08 ContactDetailResponse extension: Adding `consent_status` to the existing schema and contact_service.get_contact_detail requires a LEFT JOIN on `biometric_consent`. The join must be guarded so the field returns `"none"` when BiometricConsent table doesn't exist yet in tests (though P01 + T01 migration will create it). Since SQLite tests use `create_all`, the table will exist when tests run; no migration guard needed for tests, but the field must have a default `"none"` in the Pydantic schema.

8. T07 `reassign_subject_contact` signature mismatch: The existing `EnrollmentService.reassign_subject_contact` takes `compreface_subject_id: str` (the CompreFace UUID string), but the orphan relink endpoint will have a `ComprefaceSubject.id` (integer PK). The router must look up the `compreface_subject_id` string from the integer PK before calling the service, or the service must be overloaded/wrapped.

9. Alembic `down_revision` chain: The new migration's `down_revision` must be `"eed28c4ef46a"` (not `g7h8i9j0k1l2` or any other). The current head after eed28c4ef46a must be confirmed before creating the migration to avoid a forked revision graph. There are 10 migration files visible; the chain must be linear.
